controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: {{company}}, {{address}}. Data in this application is processed on behalf of your employer.

data.title: Data processed
data.body: Identity and contact details, contract and pay information, leave requests, sick leave, telework and meetings, HR documents, sign-in logs. Sick leave may be health data: it is limited to what is strictly necessary and every access is logged.

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.body: Personnel administration, absence and working time tracking, payroll, internal communication and information system security. Monthly feedback is anonymous and is never linked to a person.

retention.title: Retention periods
retention.body:
Audit log: {{audit}} days.
Notifications: {{notif}} days.
Contact requests: {{contact}} days.
Anonymous feedback: {{feedback}} months.
Former employee file: {{years}} year(s), then automatic anonymization.

security.title: Security
security.body: Hashed passwords (Argon2id), two-factor authentication, secure cookie sessions, sensitive data (salary, social security number, contact details) and documents encrypted at rest, role-based access control, audit log of data access.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may access your data, have it corrected, obtain a copy, object to processing or request erasure within legal limits. Export is available under Security. For any request: {{dpo}}. You may also contact your country's data protection authority.
